verse.sanskrit:
अपर्याप्तं तदस्माकं बलं भीष्माभिरक्षितम्।

पर्याप्तं त्विदमेतेषां बलं भीमाभिरक्षितम्।।1.10।।
verse.meaning: Our army, marshalled by Bhishma, is insufficient, whereas theirs, marshalled by Bhima, is sufficient.
verse.insight: In this verse, Krishna highlights purposeful action and mental clarity. Direct your energy toward fulfilling your rightful duty without being paralyzed by doubts or external turbulence. Focus entirely on the action directly in front of you. Let the outcome take care of itself.
